comment: M10-SPEC §7.5 and PICKERS-SPEC §2: one rule for team boundaries. The relay is the authority; the console server, the console UI and the plugin (what the relay hands the host, what a member accepted) accept exactly the same inputs. Every implementation's tests load this file and expand every placeholder (a string value equal to a key of placeholders) as its text says. valid and invalid are PUT bodies' boundaries (invalid: 400 invalid_body; field names the boundaries field at fault, null for the body itself); m10_documents are documents the M10 code wrote: a PUT body of that shape is 400 invalid_body, and a reader of a stored or returned document treats the absent github_repos and drive_folders as empty. normalised is what the relay stores for a valid body. legacy_drives is the PUT rule for drives against the document stored (ok false: 400 legacy_drive). keys and item_keys are PICKERS-SPEC §2.2. since is §2.3 rules 1-4. sources is the status group of PICKERS-SPEC §3.3 (invalid: 400 invalid_body; kept: what the relay stores of a valid one).

a stored one and a new one
the name with a space added

since.comment: start is a document the M10 code stored as version 1 (no github_repos or drive_folders, and its since has no github_repos or drive_folders map); each step is the next PUT (version 2, 3, ...) and the since the relay answers with. Every step is valid, keeps only the legacy drives already stored, and since holds the items of the document as stored (duplicates and repositories of whole orgs dropped).

steps.why: rule 2: the whole org narrowed to two of its repositories keeps the org since; the legacy drive kept keeps its since
rule 1 for a repository spelt in another case; rule 4 for a new repository of an org that was not whole; the legacy drive re-picked as a whole drive and a folder is new
rule 3: a folder of a whole drive the replaced version holds gets the drive since; a pasted folder (no drive id) is new; member folders allowed
rule 4: the org added back after its removal is new; its repositories are dropped from the document (the whole org covers them)
rule 2 again: narrowed to a repository it held before the org came back, it takes the org since, not its old one
rule 4: the folder added back is new (the replaced version holds no whole drive); member folders allowed again are new
the whole drive added back is new
rule 3 with the drive since: a new folder of that drive gets it; a folder of another drive is new; folders held keep their own

missing: not a key of the team, but well formed: the relay drops it

kept.why: only keys of items of the current boundaries are kept, in the order sent
a repository of a whole-org entry is not an item, so its key is dropped
a key repeated is kept once
